# The Fifth Kind

> The Fifth Kind is an AI agency in Bangalore, India that creates cinematic AI video content and builds AI automation for businesses. Tagline: "Your brand, on screen. Powered by AI." Studio-quality deliverables in days, not weeks — never generic AI output.

Website: https://www.the5thkind.in/

## Services

### Create — AI video & content
- **AI Product Video** (15–45 sec): AI-generated visuals with clean concept and polished editing, for product launches and ads.
- **AI Clone Video** (up to 30 sec): a hyper-realistic digital clone with the client's voice and likeness — be on camera without a shoot.
- **AI Character & Story Video**: cinematic brand storytelling built around AI characters.
- **Reel Edit**: professional editing of existing footage — pacing, sound and hooks tuned for retention.
- **Brand & Ad Film** (1–3 min): full production including script, direction and colour grading.

### Automate — AI customer engagement & operations
- **WhatsApp Automation**: AI chatbots for 24/7 customer interaction on WhatsApp.
- **AI Voice Agent**: conversational voice AI for phone engagement.
- **Custom AI Chatbot**: a chatbot trained on the client's product list, categories and FAQs that answers customer questions on their website 24/7 and passes hot leads to the team.
- **AI Agents & Business Automation**: AI agents that automate quotations, invoices, billing, payment reminders, lead follow-ups and order updates. Includes free automation consulting — The Fifth Kind studies how a business runs and maps what to automate first.

## Who it serves

SMEs, enterprises, startups and traditional businesses across India and abroad — with deep experience in luxury retail, D2C wellness, personal brands and product launches.

## Why clients choose The Fifth Kind

- Story-first: every project starts with narrative and concept, not a prompt.
- Speed: AI production pipeline delivers studio-quality work in days, not weeks.
- Full stack: one studio for both content creation (video) and automation (chatbots, agents, voice).
- Free 15-minute consultation and free AI content audit available via WhatsApp.
